title: Agent Sprite Forge shared contract types
description: Frozen contracts, version 1. Building blocks referenced by the sprite, video, map, codeart and media schemas. Canonical copy in shared/schemas; tools/vendor_sync.py copies it byte for byte into skills/*/references/schemas. Objects stay open (additionalProperties true): producers may add optional fields. Pixel boxes are half-open [x0, y0, x1, y1); paths are manifest-relative POSIX.

relPath.description: Manifest-relative POSIX path: forward slashes only, no leading slash, no drive letter and no URL scheme. '..' segments are allowed. Inputs on another drive record their file name plus sha256.

fileRef.description: A file the document depends on, bound to its content by sha256.

toolInfo.description: A tool or renderer and its exact version.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, for example 2026-10-05T04:16:00Z.

qaStatus.description: Overall verdict of a QA document. needs-visual-review means the numbers passed but a human or agent must still look.

qaCheck.description: One measured check. value and threshold are whatever the check measures (number, list, boolean or null).

qaEnvelope.description: Every QA JSON states its method, what it does not prove, and the sha256 of every input and output it judged. A pass envelope cannot contain a failed check. createdAt is optional so QA files can stay byte-deterministic.

artSource.description: Where the art came from. Record a separate boolean placeholder for stand-in art.

provenance.description: How an output was produced: the tool, its version, the parameters and the hashed inputs.

box.description: Half-open pixel box [x0, y0, x1, y1) in the PIL convention: x1 and y1 are exclusive.

rectXYWH.description: Rectangle [x, y, width, height] with its top-left corner at (x, y).

padding4.description: Padding [left, top, right, bottom] in whole pixels.

polygon.description: A closed polygon as at least three [x, y] vertices; the last vertex joins the first.

hexColor.description: #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where AA 00 marks an erasing palette entry.

rgb.description: An [r, g, b] colour with 8-bit channels.

color.description: A colour as a hex string or an [r, g, b] triple.

keyColor.description: A chroma-key colour: a declared key name or an explicit colour.

eventName.description: Gameplay event names shared by clips, selections and runtimes; anything else uses the custom: prefix.

fpsValue.description: Frame rate as a positive number or an exact rational string such as 24000/1001.

durationsMs.description: Per-frame durations in whole milliseconds (forge_core.frame_durations sums exactly to the clip length).

loopPolicy.description: cycle repeats from the first frame, pingpong mirrors without duplicating end frames, oneshot plays once and holds.

sampling.description: Runtime texture sampling: nearest for pixel art, linear for painted art.

shadow.description: Ground shadow ellipse in source pixels, centred on the root.
